interface.name: niri_rdp_cursor_manager_v1
interface.description: Available only on the isolated headless compositor to unrestricted clients. Cursor coordinates and sizes are physical output pixels. RGBA images are premultiplied, top-down, tightly packed; files are sealed and bounded to 384x384. This extension is private to the maintained Niri-RDP pin.

event.name: unsupported
event.description: The output/cursor cannot be represented. Clients must retain embedded capture until a later valid shape or hidden event. No pixels follow.
